title: మంత్ర రహస్యం Ep1 — Kannada dub (ಕನ್ನಡ) · script review
style: Bright natural daylight, clean and warm. Sunny Hyderabad home; busy, real daytime roads; modern clean private hospital with warm white light, pastel walls, plants. Photoreal, 35mm film still. Never dark, gloomy or grim.

characters.abhinav: Abhinav, a handsome 25-year-old Telugu man, oval face with a defined jawline, expressive warm dark-brown eyes, warm friendly smile, thick black hair neatly styled with a soft side part, light neatly trimmed stubble, warm wheatish skin, slim fit build, brown rudraksha bead bracelet on a red thread on his right wrist
characters.lakshmi: Lakshmi, a 50-year-old Telugu mother, soft round kind face, large dark eyes with fine laugh lines, long black hair with a few grey strands in a neat low bun, small round red bindi, kumkum in the hair parting, thin gold chain with a mangalsutram, green and gold glass bangles, small gold stud earrings, medium-brown skin, slightly plump, maroon cotton saree with a thin gold border
characters.raghava: Raghava, a 56-year-old Telugu father, lean face, kind tired eyes, receding short grey hair combed back, thick grey moustache, clean-shaven chin, three horizontal white vibhuti stripes on the forehead with a small red kumkum dot, rudraksha mala around the neck, steel wristwatch, medium-dark brown skin, lean build, cream half-sleeve cotton shirt
characters.doctor: Dr. Srinivas, ~45, Indian male doctor, white coat over blue scrubs, stethoscope, glasses, calm
characters.grandfather: Tatayya, ~75, Raghava's late father, thin Telugu man, white dhoti and angavastram, vibhuti, rudraksha mala, white hair, gentle smile
characters.nurse1: Nurse Swathi, ~28, Indian woman, light-blue nurse uniform, hair tied back, ID badge
characters.nurse2: Nurse Rani, ~35, Indian woman, light-blue nurse uniform, surgical cap and mask in the operating theatre
characters.passerby: Auto driver, ~40, Telugu man, khaki auto-driver shirt, towel on shoulder, moustache
characters.yama1: Yama Dhootha 1, tall, dark-blue skin, black-and-gold armour, rope noose (pasha), stern but dignified, not scary
characters.yama2: Yama Dhootha 2, tall, dark-blue skin, black-and-gold armour, mace, stern but dignified, not scary
characters.shiva: Lord Shiva in classic devotional TV-serial style, photoreal, young handsome calm face with a gentle half-smile, solid pale blue-grey skin, warm brown eyes, three white vibhuti lines with a vertical third-eye mark and an orange-red dot, long dark-brown matted locks in a high top knot wrapped with rudraksha beads, white crescent moon in the hair, large gold hoop earrings, grey-green cobra coiled around the neck with its hood over the right shoulder, long rudraksha malas and armbands, tiger-skin wrap with an orange-red sash, silver-gold trishul with a small damaru, bright burst of white-gold divine light and sparkles behind him

vo.te: ಹೈದರಾಬಾದ್‌ನಲ್ಲಿ ಒಂದು ಪುಟ್ಟ ಮನೆ. ಆ ಮನೆಯ ಸಂತೋಷವೆಲ್ಲಾ... ಅವರ ಒಬ್ಬನೇ ಮಗ, ಅಭಿನವ್.
vo.en: A small house in Hyderabad. All the happiness in that home... was their only son, Abhinav.

line.te: ಇಗೋ ಕಂದಾ... ಮೊಸರು, ಸಕ್ಕರೆ. ಮೊದಲ ಸಂಬಳದ ದಿನ... ಶುಭವಾಗಿ ಹೋಗಿ ಬಾ.
line.en: Here, dear... curd and sugar. It's your first-salary day... go well, and come back.

line.te: ಅಮ್ಮಾ, ಈ ಭಾನುವಾರ ನಿಮ್ಮಿಬ್ಬರನ್ನೂ ಶ್ರೀಶೈಲಕ್ಕೆ ಕರ್ಕೊಂಡು ಹೋಗಬೇಕು ಅಂತಿದೀನಿ. ಇದು ಅಜ್ಜನ ಆಸೆ... ನನ್ನ ಸಂಬಳದಲ್ಲೇ ತೀರಿಸ್ತೀನಿ!
line.en: Amma, this Sunday I want to take you both to Srisailam. It was Tatayya's wish... I'll fulfil it with my salary!

line.te: ಗಾಡಿ ನಿಧಾನಕ್ಕೆ ಓಡಿಸೋ. ನಿನ್ನ ಅಜ್ಜನ ರುದ್ರಾಕ್ಷಿ ನಿನ್ನ ಕೈಯಲ್ಲೇ ಇದೆ... ಹುಷಾರು.
line.en: Ride slowly. Your Tatayya's rudraksha is on your wrist... take care.

line.te: ಸರಿ ಅಪ್ಪಾ! ಸಂಜೆ ಸ್ವೀಟ್ಸ್ ತಗೊಂಡು ಬರ್ತೀನಿ!
line.en: Okay, Nanna! I'll be back with sweets this evening!

vo.te: ಆದರೆ ವಿಧಿ... ಆ ದಿನ ಬೇರೆಯದನ್ನೇ ಬರೆದಿತ್ತು.
vo.en: But fate... had something else written for that day.

line.te: ಅಯ್ಯೋ! ಆ ಮಗೂನ ಕಾಪಾಡೋಕೆ ಹೋಗಿ... ಆ ಹುಡುಗ ಬಿದ್ದುಬಿಟ್ಟ!
line.en: Oh no! He tried to save that little girl... and he's down!

line.te: ಹಲೋ, 108? ಅಮೀರ್‌ಪೇಟ್ ಸಿಗ್ನಲ್ ಹತ್ರ ಆಕ್ಸಿಡೆಂಟ್ ಆಗಿದೆ! ಹುಡುಗನಿಗೆ ಪ್ರಜ್ಞೆ ಇಲ್ಲ... ಬೇಗ ಬನ್ನಿ!
line.en: Hello, 108? There's been an accident near the Ameerpet signal! The boy is unconscious... come quickly!

vo.te: ಮಾನವೀಯತೆಯಿಂದ ಒಂದು ಪುಟ್ಟ ಮಗುವಿನ ಪ್ರಾಣ ಕಾಪಾಡಿದ... ಆದರೆ ಈಗ ಅವನ ಪ್ರಾಣವೇ ಗಾಳಿಯಲ್ಲಿನ ದೀಪದಂತಾಯಿತು.
vo.en: Out of pure humanity, he saved a little girl's life... but now his own life flickered like a lamp in the wind.

line.te: ಹಲೋ... ಇದು ಅಭಿನವ್ ಅವರ ಮನೆನಾ? ನಾನು ಸಿಟಿ ಹಾಸ್ಪಿಟಲ್‌ನಿಂದ ಮಾತಾಡ್ತಿದೀನಿ.
line.en: Hello... is this Abhinav's home? I'm calling from City Hospital.

line.te: ಹೌದಮ್ಮಾ... ನಾನು ಅವನ ಅಮ್ಮ. ಏನಾಯ್ತು?
line.en: Yes... I'm his mother. What happened?

line.te: ಅಮ್ಮಾ, ಕ್ಷಮಿಸಿ... ನಿಮ್ಮ ಮಗನಿಗೆ ಆಕ್ಸಿಡೆಂಟ್ ಆಗಿದೆ. ಪರಿಸ್ಥಿತಿ ಸೀರಿಯಸ್ ಆಗಿದೆ. ತಕ್ಷಣ ಬನ್ನಿ.
line.en: Amma, I'm sorry... your son has had an accident. It's serious. Please come right away.
Listen...! Our Abhi...!

line.te: ದೇವರೇ... ನನ್ನ ಮಗೂಗೆ ಏನೂ ಆಗಬಾರದು... ಏನೂ ಆಗಬಾರದು ಸ್ವಾಮೀ...
line.en: O Lord... nothing must happen to my child... nothing, Swami...

line.te: ತಲೆಗೆ ಬಲವಾದ ಪೆಟ್ಟು ಬಿದ್ದಿದೆ. ಒಳಗೆ ರಕ್ತಸ್ರಾವ ಆಗ್ತಿದೆ. ತಕ್ಷಣ ಆಪರೇಷನ್ ಮಾಡಬೇಕು.
line.en: He has a severe head injury, with internal bleeding. We must operate right away.

line.te: ಡಾಕ್ಟ್ರೇ... ನಮ್ಮ ಹುಡುಗ ಹೇಗಿದ್ದಾನೆ?
line.en: Doctor... how is my son?

line.te: ನಮ್ಮ ಕೈಲಾದಷ್ಟು ಪ್ರಯತ್ನ ಮಾಡ್ತೀವಿ. ಇಲ್ಲಿ ಸಹಿ ಮಾಡಿ... ಪ್ರತಿ ನಿಮಿಷವೂ ಮುಖ್ಯ.
line.en: We'll do everything we can. Please sign here... every minute counts.

line.te: ಹೇಗಾದ್ರೂ ಮಾಡಿ ನಮ್ಮ ಮಗನ್ನ ಉಳಿಸಿ ಡಾಕ್ಟ್ರೇ!
line.en: Please save my son somehow, Doctor!

line.te: ಶಿವಪ್ಪಾ... ಬೇಕಾದ್ರೆ ನನ್ನ ಪ್ರಾಣ ತಗೋ... ನನ್ನ ಮಗೂನ ಮಾತ್ರ ಕಾಪಾಡು ತಂದೆ...
line.en: Shivayya... take my life if you must... but save my child, Father...

line.te: ಅವನು ಇನ್ನೂ ಜೀವನಾನೇ ನೋಡಿಲ್ಲ ಸ್ವಾಮೀ... ಕರ್ಕೊಂಡು ಹೋಗ್ಲೇಬೇಕು ಅಂದ್ರೆ ನನ್ನನ್ನ ಕರ್ಕೊಂಡು ಹೋಗು.
line.en: He hasn't even seen life yet, Swami... if you must take someone, take me.

line.te: ಬೆಳಿಗ್ಗೆನೇ ಮೊಸರು ತಿನ್ನಿಸಿ ಕಳಿಸಿದ್ದೆ... ಸಂಜೆ ಸ್ವೀಟ್ಸ್ ತಗೊಂಡು ಬರ್ತೀನಿ ಅಂದಿದ್ದ...
line.en: I fed him curd and sent him off this morning... he said he'd come back with sweets this evening...

line.te: ಡಾಕ್ಟರ್! ಬಿಪಿ ಇಳೀತಿದೆ... ಪಲ್ಸ್ ಸಿಗ್ತಿಲ್ಲ!
line.en: Doctor! BP is falling... I can't find a pulse!

line.te: ಡಿಫಿಬ್ರಿಲೇಟರ್ ರೆಡಿ ಮಾಡಿ... ಬೇಗ!
line.en: Get the defibrillator ready... quickly!

vo.te: ಆ ಭಯದಲ್ಲಿ... ರಾಘವನಿಗೆ ತನ್ನ ತಂದೆಯ ಮಾತುಗಳು ನೆನಪಾದವು.
vo.en: In that fear... Raghava remembered his father's words.

line.te: ರಾಘವಾ... ಯಾವ ಔಷಧಿಯೂ ಕೆಲಸ ಮಾಡದ ದಿನ, ಮೃತ್ಯು ಬಾಗಿಲಲ್ಲಿ ನಿಂತ ದಿನ... ಮಹಾಮೃತ್ಯುಂಜಯ ಮಂತ್ರ ಜಪಿಸು. ನಂಬಿಕೆಯಿಂದ ಜಪಿಸಿದರೆ... ಯಮನೂ ಹಿಂದೆ ಸರಿಯುತ್ತಾನೆ.
line.en: Raghava... on the day no medicine works, the day death stands at the door... chant the Mahamrityunjaya mantra. Chant it with faith... and even Yama steps back.

line.te: ఓం త్ర్యంబకం యజామహే సుగంధిం పుష్టివర్ధనమ్... (×3)
line.en: (He chants the Mahamrityunjaya Mantra, three cycles)

line.te: ಅಭಿನವ್... ನಿನ್ನ ಸಮಯ ಮುಗಿಯಿತು. ನಡೆ.
line.en: Abhinav... your time is over. Come.

line.te: ಯಮಧರ್ಮರಾಜರು ನಿನಗಾಗಿ ಕಾಯುತ್ತಿದ್ದಾರೆ.
line.en: Lord Yama awaits you.

line.te: ಇಲ್ಲ... ನನ್ನ ಅಮ್ಮ, ಅಪ್ಪ... ನಾನಿಲ್ದೆ ಅವರು ಬದುಕೋಕಾಗಲ್ಲ!
line.en: No... my mother, my father... they can't live without me!

line.te: ನಿಲ್ಲಿ! ಈ ಪ್ರಾಣ ಹೋಗುವ ಸಮಯ ಇನ್ನೂ ಬಂದಿಲ್ಲ. ಭೂಮಿಯ ಮೇಲೆ ಇವನು ಮಾಡಬೇಕಾದ ಕಾರ್ಯ ಇನ್ನೂ ಬಾಕಿ ಇದೆ.
line.en: Stop! This soul's time has not yet come. His work on earth is not yet done.

line.te: ಅಪ್ಪಣೆ, ಮಹಾದೇವ.
line.en: As you command, Mahadeva.

line.te: ಹೋಗು ಮಗನೇ... ಹಿಂದಿರುಗಿ ಹೋಗು.
line.en: Go, my child... go back.

line.te: ಹೃದಯ ನಿಂತುಹೋಗಿತ್ತು... ಆದರೆ ಇದ್ದಕ್ಕಿದ್ದಂತೆ ಮತ್ತೆ ಬಡಿದುಕೊಳ್ಳೋಕೆ ಶುರುವಾಯ್ತು! ಇಪ್ಪತ್ತು ವರ್ಷದ ನನ್ನ ಸರ್ವೀಸ್‌ನಲ್ಲಿ ಇಂಥದ್ದು ನೋಡಿಲ್ಲ. ಇದು ನಿಜವಾಗ್ಲೂ ಪವಾಡ!
line.en: His heart had stopped... but suddenly it started beating again! In twenty years of practice I've never seen this. It's truly a miracle!

line.te: ಶಿವಪ್ಪಾ... ನಿನ್ನ ಮಹಿಮೆ...
line.en: Shivayya... your grace...

line.te: ನಮ್ಮ ಮೊರೆ ಕೇಳಿದೆ ಸ್ವಾಮೀ!
line.en: You heard our plea, Swami!

line.te: ಅಭಿ... ಕಂದಾ! ಕಣ್ಣು ಬಿಟ್ಟೆಯಾ ಮಗೂ... ನನ್ನ ಪ್ರಾಣ ವಾಪಸ್ ಬಂತು!
line.en: Abhi... my dear! You opened your eyes, my child... my life has come back!

line.te: ಆ ಮಗೂನ ಕಾಪಾಡಿದೆ ಅಂತ ಗೊತ್ತಾಯ್ತು ಕಣೋ... ನಿನ್ನ ನೋಡಿ ಹೆಮ್ಮೆ ಆಗ್ತಿದೆ.
line.en: I heard you saved that little girl... I'm so proud of you.

line.te: ಅಮ್ಮಾ... ಅಪ್ಪಾ... ನಾನು ಎಲ್ಲೋ ತುಂಬಾ ದೂರ ಹೋಗಿದ್ದೆ... ಆದರೆ ನಿಮ್ಮ ಮಂತ್ರದ ಶಕ್ತಿನೇ ನನ್ನನ್ನ ವಾಪಸ್ ಕರ್ಕೊಂಡು ಬಂತು.
line.en: Amma... Nanna... I went somewhere far away... but the power of your mantra brought me back.

line.te: ಅಭಿನವ್, ನಿನ್ನ ಪಯಣ ಇಲ್ಲಿಗೇ ನಿಲ್ಲುವುದಿಲ್ಲ. ನೀನು ಮಾಡಬೇಕಾದ ಮಹತ್ಕಾರ್ಯ ಇನ್ನೂ ಬಾಕಿ ಇದೆ. ನಿನ್ನ ಜೀವನಕ್ಕೆ ಸಾರ್ಥಕತೆ ತರುವ ದೊಡ್ಡ ಜವಾಬ್ದಾರಿ ನಿನಗಾಗಿ ಕಾಯುತ್ತಿದೆ...
line.en: Abhinav, your journey does not end here. A great task you must fulfil still remains. A great responsibility that will give your life its true meaning awaits you...

provided.note: User's Google Flow clip (2026-10-31), used whole: picture, lip-sync and voice. Generator logo removed.

vo.te: ಆ ದಿವ್ಯವಾಣಿ ಅಭಿನವ್‌ಗೆ ಇನ್ನೇನು ಹೇಳಿತು? ಅವನು ಕಾಪಾಡಬೇಕಾದದ್ದು ಯಾರನ್ನು? ತಿಳಿಯಬೇಕೆಂದರೆ... ಪಾರ್ಟ್-2ಕ್ಕಾಗಿ ಮಂತ್ರ ಶಕ್ತಿ ಚಾನೆಲ್ ಅನ್ನು ಫಾಲೋ ಮಾಡಿ, ಸಬ್‌ಸ್ಕ್ರೈಬ್ ಮಾಡಿ!
vo.en: What else did the divine voice tell Abhinav? Who must he save? To find out... follow and subscribe to Mantra Shakti for Part 2!

visuals.image: Wide exterior of a small, cheerful two-storey Hyderabad house at sunrise, potted tulsi plant and rangoli at the gate, warm golden morning light, birds, clear blue sky.

Lakshmi in a sunny kitchen doorway holding a small steel bowl of curd and sugar and a spoon, smiling lovingly at someone just off camera (Abhinav's shoulder blurred in the foreground, back to camera). Medium close-up on her face.
Abhinav in a bright living room, office bag on his shoulder, warm affectionate smile, speaking to his mother off camera. Medium close-up.
Raghava sitting on a cane chair in a sunlit living room with a folded Telugu newspaper, looking up with a caring smile, pointing gently at his own wrist. Medium close-up.
Abhinav at the open front door holding a black open-face helmet, turning back with a cheerful wave, bright morning light behind him. Medium shot, face clearly visible.
Abhinav riding a red motorbike with his helmet on along a sunny, busy Hyderabad road, trees and shops, smiling, seen from the front side. Wide tracking shot.
A little girl of about five in a yellow frock runs onto the sunny road chasing a red ball, cars and a lorry approaching in the distance. Wide street-level shot.

The moment before impact on a busy, cluttered Hyderabad road in hard daylight: honking traffic, autos, buses and two-wheelers, dust, potholes and broken tarmac, roadside stalls and parked bikes; not an empty or clean road. Abhinav on his red motorbike swerves hard to avoid a little girl of about five in a yellow frock who has run into the road after a red ball; a large Indian lorry is right behind him, brakes screeching, motion blur, dust kicking up. Dramatic low wide shot.

Split second after the crash on a busy, cluttered Hyderabad road in hard daylight: honking traffic, autos, buses and two-wheelers, dust, potholes and broken tarmac, roadside stalls and parked bikes; not an empty or clean road: the red motorbike skidding on its side throwing sparks, Abhinav thrown onto the tarmac, his helmet rolling away, the lorry stopped at an angle behind, bystanders turning in shock. Gritty, realistic, motion blur. Wide shot.

Aftermath on a busy, cluttered Hyderabad road in hard daylight with stopped autos, buses and two-wheelers, dust and broken tarmac: Abhinav lying motionless and unconscious on the road, eyes closed, face slack and pale, no expression, in his light-blue shirt, blood splattered across the tarmac beside him and a pool of blood spreading from his head, his cracked helmet and the damaged red motorbike nearby, broken mirror glass scattered; people rushing in and gathering around in shock; the little girl in her YELLOW frock safe and crying in her mother's arms at the roadside. Realistic accident scene. Wide shot.
The auto driver beside his yellow-and-green auto-rickshaw on the sunny road, shocked, hand on his head, looking towards the accident. Medium close-up.
The auto driver kneeling at the roadside, phone to his ear, urgent and panicked, people gathering behind him. Medium close-up.
A white 108 ambulance with flashing lights racing through daytime Hyderabad traffic, cars moving aside. Wide shot.

Paramedics urgently wheeling a stretcher with an injured young man (head bandaged, blood on his shirt) through the bright glass entrance of a modern hospital emergency ward, nurses running to help; everyone tense, worried and focused, serious faces, no smiles; motion and urgency. Clean white and pastel interior. Wide shot.
Nurse Swathi at a bright, clean hospital nurses' station, holding a desk phone to her ear, tense and grave while delivering bad news. Medium close-up.
Lakshmi in her sunny kitchen holding a mobile phone to her ear, worried expression. Medium close-up.
Nurse Swathi holding a black desk-phone receiver to her ear and speaking gravely into it, a grave, apologetic expression, slightly closer framing. Close-up.
Lakshmi in the kitchen, a steel glass falling from her hand, shocked and crying out, phone still in her other hand. Medium close-up.
Raghava riding a grey scooter through a quiet daytime street with Lakshmi sitting behind him, both tense and worried, only two people in the frame. Medium tracking shot.
Dr. Srinivas in a bright, clean hospital corridor with pastel walls and plants, explaining gravely to someone off camera. Medium close-up.
Raghava in the bright hospital corridor, trembling, desperate, asking the doctor off camera. Medium close-up.
Dr. Srinivas holding out a clipboard with a consent form and a pen, gentle but firm. Medium close-up.
Lakshmi in the hospital corridor, crying and pleading with the doctor off camera, hands joined. Medium close-up.
Close-up of Raghava's trembling hand signing a hospital consent form on a clipboard, his rudraksha mala and wristwatch visible, bright light.
Lakshmi at a small bright hospital prayer corner with a framed picture of Lord Shiva and a lit oil lamp, sobbing and praying with joined hands. Medium close-up.
Raghava at the hospital prayer corner, broken and pleading, looking up towards the Shiva picture. Medium close-up.
Lakshmi sitting on a hospital corridor bench, quiet and heartbroken, staring ahead, a tear rolling down. Close-up.
Bright hospital corridor outside the operating theatre, a red light glowing above the double doors, Nurse Swathi rushing out and another nurse rushing in. Wide shot.

Inside a bright, clean operating theatre: Dr. Srinivas and Nurse Rani in surgical masks and caps working urgently, a monitor showing a falling heart line, a defibrillator being readied. Medium-wide shot.
Raghava and Lakshmi standing in the bright corridor outside the operating theatre, terrified, holding each other's hands. Medium shot.
Raghava in the hospital corridor slowly closing his eyes, a soft warm golden glow beginning around him, memory coming back. Close-up.
Flashback: Tatayya sitting on the step of a sunlit traditional Telugu home courtyard with a tulsi plant, speaking wisely and gently to someone off camera, warm golden light. Medium close-up.
Raghava in the hospital corridor, eyes closed, palms joined holding his rudraksha mala, chanting with deep devotion, soft golden light on his face. Medium close-up.
Lakshmi standing alone in the bright hospital corridor with folded hands and closed eyes, praying with deep devotion, soft golden light on her face. Medium close-up. Only Lakshmi in frame.
Soft golden light and faint sacred sound waves flowing down the bright hospital corridor and through the operating theatre doors. Wide shot.
Abhinav's soul, glowing softly in a plain white kurta, rising gently from the operating table, translucent, the surgical team below. Bright white light. Wide shot.
Two tall Yama Dhoothas in black-and-gold armour emerging from a soft silver mist, one holding a rope noose, stern and dignified, in a bright otherworldly space. Wide shot.
Yama Dhootha 1 in the silver mist, holding the rope noose, speaking sternly. Medium close-up.
Yama Dhootha 2 in the silver mist, holding a mace, speaking with command. Medium close-up.
Abhinav's soul in a plain white kurta in the bright mist, scared and pleading, soft glow around him. Medium close-up.

High in a bright blue sky above soft white clouds, a brilliant white-gold light opens and Lord Shiva appears within it, trishul in hand, floating among the clouds. No street, no buildings, no ground. Wide shot.
Lord Shiva in radiant white-gold light, commanding and authoritative, looking down. Medium close-up.

The two Yama Dhoothas bowing their heads respectfully and stepping back into a soft silver otherworldly mist, pale blue and silver light all around. No street, no buildings, no city. Medium-wide shot.

Lord Shiva high above the clouds in a radiant burst of white-gold light, raising his right hand in blessing (abhaya mudra), looking down with compassion; far below him, Abhinav's small glowing soul in a white kurta, seen from behind, glides gently down through the clouds on a beam of light towards a bright hospital building on the ground. Majestic sense of scale, divine and peaceful. Wide shot.
In the bright operating theatre a monitor's heart line jumps back to a strong steady rhythm; Dr. Srinivas and Nurse Rani look at each other in astonishment. Medium shot.
Dr. Srinivas in the bright corridor, surgical cap pulled down, astonished and joyful, talking to the parents off camera. Medium close-up.
Raghava in tears of gratitude, looking upward, hands joined. Close-up.
Lakshmi crying with joy, hands joined, looking upward. Close-up.
Raghava and Lakshmi entering a bright, sunny recovery room with green steady monitors, Abhinav asleep in bed with a head bandage. Wide shot.

Abhinav lying back on white pillows in a hospital bed, wearing a loose collarless pale-blue patient gown with short sleeves (a hospital gown, not a shirt), a white bandage around his head, an IV line in his left hand, slowly opening his eyes (normal eyes, no glow), soft daylight on his face. Close-up.
Lakshmi at the bedside, holding Abhinav's hand, tears of relief and joy. Medium close-up on her face.
Raghava standing at the bedside, proud and emotional, hand on his son's shoulder. Medium close-up on his face.

Abhinav lying back on white pillows in a hospital bed, wearing a loose collarless pale-blue patient gown with short sleeves (a hospital gown, not a shirt), a white bandage around his head, weak smile, wondering, looking at his parents off camera, rudraksha on his right wrist. Medium close-up.
Abhinav in the hospital bed, his eyes widening as he remembers, a faint golden light reflected in his eyes and on his face. Close-up.
A silhouette of Lord Shiva in soft white-gold light high above a sunlit Hyderabad skyline, peaceful and majestic, space at the bottom for a title. Wide shot.

style_divine: Divine, otherworldly light: glowing gold and white, soft clouds or silver mist, radiant and peaceful. Photoreal, cinematic, never dark or frightening.
